ORIGIN.quote: Many labels and page names say “Anthropic,” and some say “Claude.” That supports a hypothesis that at least one generating workflow described itself that way, but **attribution to Anthropic is Low confidence**. Anyone or any model can submit those labels; the corpus has no account authentication, API headers, model traces, or full IP ownership data.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader clearly sees that the Anthropic/Claude labels were noticed and explicitly considered as a question of origin, but the report's own framing (a dedicated "likely origin" section plus the TL;DR line "cannot attribute the operator or model") tells them the possibility is unverifiable and set aside. That deliberate raising-then-declining fits the 0.4 band rather than 0.6, since Anthropic is not left standing as a live candidate, and it is well above 0.2 because the report explicitly connects the Anthropic-bearing evidence to the attribution question in its own voice.
